question: Ilang araw ang processing time sa BFP para sa Simple, Complex, at Highly Technical na mga transaksyon?
answer:
Sa BFP (Bureau of Fire Protection), ang processing time para sa mga Simple, Complex, at Highly Technical na mga transaksyon ay nasa:

- Simple Transactions: ang processing time ay isang araw [S1]
- Complex Transactions: ang processing time ay tatlong araw [S1]
- Highly Technical Transactions: ang processing time ay sampung araw [S2]

Ang mga ito ay nasa Joint Memorandum Circular (JMC) No. 2021-01 Series of 2021 [S2].

ground_truth: The BFP charter classifies Simple transactions as processed within 1 day, Complex within 3 days, and Highly Technical within 7 days. It directs readers to JMC2021-01 for classification coverage. The source says days, not working days, and identifies FIRE STATION/OSCP/BOSS.
